description: Jurisdictions that at least one independent tracker lists with an adopted or formally proposed moratorium (tracker status adopted/proposed, not classified by us as a ban) and that do not match any inventory row after name normalization and a sector check. Each group merges all tracker entries for the same state+jurisdiction. Absence was checked with scripts/show_rows.py --state XX --list (show_rows_near_matches lists same-name rows, usually a different body or sector). Verdicts: GAP_ADOPTED (one search confirmed an adopted temporary pause), GAP_ADOPTED_LIKELY (specific tracker claim, search partially corroborates), GAP_PENDING (formally proposed / first reading / directed to draft), UNCERTAIN, GAP_*_UNVERIFIED (BESS/renewable tracker listings not individually searched), NOT_GAP_MISATTRIBUTED (tracker put it in the wrong state or split an aggregate; we already have it), NOT_GAP_FAILED, NOT_GAP_OUT_OF_SCOPE (ban, zoning rules, nonbinding resolution).

61 of the 2026-09-23 research candidates cited the OCJ map as evidence, so OCJ agreement with those rows is not independent confirmation.

The misattribution rate is material: 19 tracker "gaps" were rows we already have, filed under the wrong state (Lowndes GA as AL, Benton MO as AR, Madison Twp OH as MI, Muhlenberg Twp OH as PA, Bell County KY as TX) or split from a county aggregate (Butler/Fayette/Wood County OH townships).
